open.title: Evotel Outage | Upington
open.description: Evotel has informed us of a network outage affecting Upington, affected clients will experience limited to no connectivity. Evotel engineers are working on resolving this issue as soon as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

updates.content:
New feeder cables have been installed, and splicing will begin tonight. We have multiple teams on site, but this remains a labour intensive repair. We apologise for the extended down time, and we aim to have service restored as soon as possible.

Teams are also travelling house-to-house assisting clients where possible. Technicians will call you directly if access to your property is necessary to complete repairs.

Evotel's technical team remains onsite and continues working to restore service to the remaining affected customers.

Evotel are pleased to confirm that the majority of affected customers are now back online. Repairs are ongoing, and the remaining customers continue to reconnect as restoration efforts progress.

Repairs are ongoing and clients are restoring in batches.

The team is continuing to investigate each fibre joint to identify and resolve any outstanding connectivity issues. This is a time-consuming task, and we apologise for the extended downtime. Work will continue into the evening.

Reason for Outage: Cable Break

Our technicians are currently tracing dead feeders along the affected fibre route and working to reduce the high fibre loss levels impacting services in the area. Technicians remain on site and are addressing faults as they are identified. Restoration efforts are currently underway.

Reason for Outage: Cable Damage
Upington is currently experiencing a network service outage. We apologise for this drop in connection. Evotel technicians are on site implementing repairs.
